assumptions: All displayed active, invited and pending records reserve one of five seats. The benchmark does not specify pending-seat accounting.
The empty fixture has no listed members; the viewing owner's permission is simulated independently.
Viewer is the safe default. Editor changes notes but cannot manage people or billing.
Only an in-memory mock service is exercised. No email, backend, persistence, billing or real authorization exists.

criteria.requirement: Email has a persistent programmatic label
Role meaning is available before selection
Seat count is visible before committing
Active, Invited and Pending differ without color alone
Main task is reachable at narrow and intermediate widths
No state falsely reports server success
Preserve the five-seat limit and existing member data; no invented billing
